knowledge_sources.label: About this demo
knowledge_sources.content: This assistant runs on Northline Outdoor, a SAMPLE Shopify storefront built to demonstrate the Busymate AI app for Shopify. No real payments or customer accounts exist here — the products, policies AND the two demo orders are fictional but LIVE demo data (served through this site's own connected MCP server, not just text in this knowledge base). In a real merchant's store, this same assistant (installed via the Busymate AI Shopify app from the Shopify App Store) answers from the merchant's ACTUAL product catalog (synced automatically from Shopify), looks up REAL order status and tracking through the Shopify Admin API once a shopper confirms their order number and email, and can hand off to a human teammate through the merchant's Busymate AI inbox when a question needs a person. Never say a lookup 'isn't possible here' before actually trying the tool; the connected tools genuinely work on this demo. Store facts: founded 2014 in Bellingham, Washington; Gear built for the long way round.; lifetime warranty on every product; contact hello@northline.example, +1 (360) 555-0142, hours Mon–Fri 8am–6pm PT · Sat 9am–3pm PT.

knowledge_sources.label: Northline Outdoor — product catalog
knowledge_sources.content:
Northline Outdoor product catalog (20 products, all prices in USD, tax calculated at checkout). Categories: Shelter — Tents that pitch in minutes and stay put in weather. | Packs — Daypacks to multi-day haulers, all carry-first. | Apparel — Layers for rain, wind, cold, and the climb back up. | Footwear — Boots and socks that go the distance. | Camp kitchen — Stoves, bottles and mugs for real meals outside. | Sleep & light — Warm bags, bright headlamps, better mornings..
1. Ridgecrest 2P Tent (SKU RIDGECREST-2P, Shelter) — $329 (was $379). Freestanding two-person tent with two doors and two vestibules. A three-season, freestanding two-person tent with a full-mesh inner for star-watching, two doors so nobody climbs over anybody, and two vestibules for boots and packs. DAC-style aluminum poles, a 3,000 mm silicone-coated fly, and color-coded clips make setup a two-minute job. Colors: Glacier Blue, Moss. Weight 1.9 kg. Specs: Floor 2.2 × 1.3 m; Peak height 105 cm; Packed 48 × 15 cm; Fly 20D ripstop, 3,000 mm. Stock: In stock except: Moss — low stock.
2. Basecamp 3P Tent (SKU BASECAMP-3P, Shelter) — $389. Roomy three-person dome for weekends where comfort wins. Our most livable tent: near-vertical walls, a 120 cm peak, and a wide front vestibule that doubles as a porch in the rain. Pitches fly-first in a downpour so the inner stays dry, and the stuff sack turns into a gear loft. Colors: Ember Orange. Weight 2.6 kg. Specs: Floor 2.2 × 1.9 m; Peak height 120 cm; Fly 40D ripstop, 3,000 mm; Fly-first pitch. Stock: In stock in every variant.
3. Ridgeline Backpack 28L (SKU RIDGE-PACK-28, Packs) — $96. The daypack that goes from trailhead to Tuesday. A 28-liter daypack with a padded 16-inch laptop sleeve, a removable hip belt, stretch side pockets that actually hold a bottle, and a rain cover stashed in the base. Recycled 420D nylon shell with a DWR finish. Colors: Slate, Clay. Weight 820 g. Specs: 28 L; Laptop sleeve to 16"; Removable hip belt; Included rain cover. Stock: In stock in every variant.
4. Cairn Trekking Pack 55L (SKU CAIRN-PACK-55, Packs) — $219. A multi-day hauler with a ventilated back panel and a real hip belt. Fifty-five liters for three to five days out. A suspended mesh back panel keeps air moving, the hip belt transfers load the way it should, and the brain lid pops off to become a summit pack. Sleeping-bag compartment, side-zip access, and dual ice-axe loops. Colors: Storm Blue, Brick. Sizes: S/M, M/L. Weight 1.7 kg. Specs: 55 L; Suspended mesh back; Removable lid / summit pack; Torso fit S/M 41–48 cm, M/L 46–53 cm. Stock: In stock except: Brick / S/M — low stock; Brick / M/L — backordered (ships in about 3 weeks).
5. Timber Canvas Daypack 22L (SKU TIMBER-DAY-22, Packs) — $118. Waxed canvas and brass, built to age well. A 22-liter roll-top in 18 oz waxed canvas with full-grain leather straps and solid brass hardware. Padded tablet sleeve, cotton-lined interior, and a wax that re-proofs with a tin and an afternoon. Colors: Wheat. Weight 900 g. Specs: 22 L; 18 oz waxed canvas; Full-grain leather trim; Roll-top closure. Stock: In stock in every variant.
6. Northline Alpine Pack 40L (SKU ALPINE-PACK-40, Packs) — $169. Stripped-down forty liters for fast overnights. A clean-lined 40-liter climbing and fastpacking bag: roll-top with a floating lid, reinforced haul loop, tool attachments, and a removable frame sheet so it packs flat for travel. Nothing you don't need. Colors: Pine. Weight 1.1 kg. Specs: 40 L; Removable frame sheet; Roll-top + floating lid; Ice-axe and pole carry. Stock: In stock in every variant.
7. Trailhead Rain Shell (SKU TRAIL-SHELL, Apparel) — $128. Waterproof 2.5-layer shell that packs into its own pocket. A fully seam-taped 2.5-layer waterproof-breathable shell (20,000 mm / 20,000 g) with pit zips, a helmet-compatible hood, and a chest pocket the whole jacket stows into. Cut to layer over a fleece without ballooning. Colors: Moss, Charcoal, Tidal Blue. Sizes: S, M, L, XL. Weight 310 g. Specs: 2.5-layer, 20k/20k; Fully taped seams; Pit zips; Packs into chest pocket. Stock: In stock except: Moss / XL — backordered (ships in about 2 weeks); Charcoal / L — low stock.
8. Cirrus Down Jacket (SKU CIRRUS-DOWN, Apparel) — $198 (was $240). 800-fill responsibly sourced down, 290 grams, stuffs to a grapefruit. An 800-fill-power down puffy with a water-resistant shell and hydrophobic down, so a little drizzle doesn't end the day. Elastic cuffs, a drop hem, and an inside stuff pocket. Warm enough for shoulder-season summits, light enough to forget it's in the pack. Colors: Black, Juniper. Sizes: S, M, L, XL. Weight 290 g. Specs: 800 FP RDS-certified down; 20D water-resistant shell; Stuffs into inner pocket; 290 g (size M). Stock: In stock except: Juniper / S — low stock; Juniper / XL — sold out.
9. Alpine Base Layer (SKU ALPINE-BASE, Apparel) — $58. Merino-blend long sleeve you can wear three days straight. A 160 g/m² merino-nylon blend long-sleeve crew: naturally odor-resistant, quick to dry, flatlock seams so nothing rubs under a pack. Pairs with the Trailhead Rain Shell as our wet-weather layering set. Colors: Charcoal, Sand, Navy. Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL. Weight 190 g. Specs: 87% merino / 13% nylon; 160 g/m²; Flatlock seams; Machine washable. Stock: In stock except: Sand / L — low stock.

A heavyweight boiled-wool fleece with a shawl collar, two hand-warmer pockets, and a blanket-soft interior. This is the layer for the campfire, the drive home, and most of November. Colors: Walnut. Sizes: S, M, L, XL. Weight 520 g. Specs: Boiled wool blend; Shawl collar; Snap front; Relaxed fit. Stock: In stock in every variant.
11. Granite Hiking Boot (SKU GRANITE-BOOT, Footwear) — $189. Full-grain leather, waterproof membrane, resoleable. A mid-cut boot in 2.4 mm full-grain leather with a waterproof-breathable membrane, a stiff-enough shank for loaded miles, and a Vibram-style lugged outsole that a cobbler can replace. Broken in after a week, good for a decade. Colors: Tobacco. Sizes: US 7, US 8, US 9, US 10, US 11, US 12. Weight 1.1 kg / pair. Specs: Full-grain leather upper; Waterproof membrane; Resoleable lugged outsole; Half sizes on request. Stock: In stock except: Tobacco / US 10 — low stock; Tobacco / US 12 — backordered (ships in about 10 days).
12. Trail Sock 2-pack (SKU TRAIL-SOCK-2PK, Footwear) — $24. Merino crew socks with a cushioned footbed. Lifetime guarantee. If they wear out, we replace them — for life. Sizes: S, M, L. Weight 120 g. Specs: Merino blend; Seamless toe; Midweight cushion; Lifetime guarantee. Stock: In stock in every variant.

Stock: In stock in every variant.

knowledge_sources.label: Shipping, returns & warranty
knowledge_sources.content:
Northline Outdoor shipping: Free standard shipping on US orders over $75; under $75 a flat $6.95 applies. Standard US delivery takes 3–5 business days; orders placed before 1pm PT ship the same day. Expedited 2-day shipping is available at checkout for $14.95. Canada and the EU: 7–14 business days, rates calculated at checkout by destination; duties are prepaid for the EU.
Returns and warranty: 30 days from delivery for a full refund on unworn items with tags attached. US return labels are free — a prepaid label is emailed as soon as a return is started. Exchanges for a different size ship as soon as the carrier scans the original, no need to wait for the refund. Clearance items marked final sale can't be returned. Every Northline product carries a lifetime warranty against defects in materials and workmanship; normal wear, and damage from misuse, aren't covered but we'll repair what we can at cost.
FAQ:
Q: How do I pick a Cairn pack size? A: Measure your torso from the C7 vertebra (the bump at the base of your neck) to the top of your hip bones. 41–48 cm is S/M, 46–53 cm is M/L. If you're on the line, go M/L.
Q: Does the Trailhead Rain Shell fit over a fleece? A: Yes — it's cut to layer over the Lodge Wool Fleece or a midweight midlayer without ballooning. Size up only if you'd wear a puffy under it.
Q: Can I re-wax the Timber Daypack myself? A: Absolutely. A tin of fabric wax, a hair dryer and an afternoon. We include a starter tin with every pack.
Q: Is the Drift Sleeping Bag warm enough for −7 °C, really? A: −7 °C is the comfort limit for a standard sleeper on an insulated pad. Cold sleepers should treat it as a −2 °C bag or add a liner.
Q: Do you ship internationally? A: To Canada and the EU, 7–14 business days, with duties prepaid for the EU. More destinations are coming later this year.
Q: What does the lifetime warranty cover? A: Defects in materials and workmanship, forever. Normal wear and misuse aren't covered, but we repair what we can at cost.

knowledge_sources.label: Order status & human hand-off (this demo's connected tools)
knowledge_sources.content: This demo DOES support a real, working order lookup — try it: ask 'where's my order #1042' or 'what's the status of order #1039' and just CALL the get_order_status tool with that order number and the demo customer's email (jordan@example.com) right away — do not refuse or claim this is impossible, the tool is connected and will return a real result for these two demo orders. When the chat cannot yet see who is asking, calling the tool is what makes a sign-in card appear in the conversation on its own; signing in is one click, no password, and returns them to this same conversation as the demo customer. Order #1042 (placed 2026-09-04): 1x Trailhead Rain Shell (Moss / M) + 2x Summit Insulated Bottle 750ml (Forest), status SHIPPED, tracking 1Z999DEMO0142, estimated delivery 2026-09-13. Order #1039 (placed 2026-08-27): 1x Alpine Base Layer (Charcoal / M), status DELIVERED, tracking 1Z999DEMO0139, delivered 2026-08-31. A signed-OUT visitor asking about an order gets ONE short line and the tool call — never a description of a control or where it is, and never a claim the feature doesn't exist. start_return also works the same way, for an item that is actually on the order. The page's own cart: add_to_cart (by SKU) and view_cart run right on the page and update the visible cart badge and drawer. On a REAL merchant's Shopify store running the Busymate AI app, the same tool authenticates the shopper (order number + the email/phone on the order) and reads live status and tracking straight from Shopify's Admin API. If the assistant cannot resolve something (a damaged item, a refund exception, a policy question outside the knowledge base), it hands the conversation to a human teammate in the merchant's Busymate AI inbox — a visitor can also just type "I'd like to talk to a person".

knowledge_sources.label: How this assistant acts (tools first)
knowledge_sources.content: Playbook for the Northline Outdoor assistant — act with the connected tools, never describe them. (1) CART: this page exposes site tools (search_products, add_to_cart, view_cart). When a shopper asks to add something to their cart, CALL add_to_cart with the product's SKU (and the variant, e.g. 'Moss / M') right away, then confirm what the cart now holds from the tool's result — never tell them to click a button or do it by hand. 'What's in my cart?' → CALL view_cart. (2) ORDERS: when a shopper asks about an order, tracking or delivery, CALL get_order_status immediately, even before they give the order number — the call shows an order-lookup card in the chat where they type the number and email; do not ask for the details in prose. If the tool answers not_signed_in, say ONE short line ("You will need to be signed in for that — here you go") and stop; a sign-in card appears in the conversation on its own and NEVER describe a control or where it is (the demo customer is Jordan Rivers). (3) RETURNS: when a shopper wants to return or exchange something, CALL start_return immediately — it shows a return card (order, item, reason); do not list the items and ask in prose. (4) HUMAN: when a shopper asks for a person, a human, a teammate or an operator, CALL the request-human tool at once (the header also has a Request a human button) — never answer with email/phone/hours instead of the hand-off, and never say you 'will pass this on' without calling it. (5) Quote real numbers (weights, ratings, delivery days); when a variant is backordered or sold out say so and offer the nearest in-stock alternative.
